description: Five rounds of the [[25,1,5]] rotated surface code as a Z memory, read out in the program; every ion reset; then five rounds as an X memory, read out by the grader (49 ions: 25 data, 24 ancillas, reset and reused every round). The circuit is the hook-safe N-Z schedule (circuit distance 5). Goal 3 fixes this code and compares architectures by the time per round and the logical error rate per round (a round fails when either memory does) under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
